t: Context is King: Prompt Fu, Mastery, and the WebOpps Devolveneer
s: This article argues that in the age of infinite content generation, context, not content, is king. It reframes AI interaction from 'prompt engineering' to 'telling a good story,' emphasizing the value of curated context for AI alignment and effective collaboration.
sub: Shift from Content Abundance to Context Value
AI Interaction as Storytelling vs. Engineering
